connectorUiConfig.title: Microsoft Dataverse
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Microsoft Dataverse is a scalable and secure data platform that enables organizations to store and manage data used by business applications. The Microsoft Dataverse data connector provides the capability to ingest Dataverse and Dynamics 365 CRM activity logs from the Microsoft Purview Audit log into Microsoft Sentinel.

dataTypes.name: DataverseActivity
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
DataverseActivity
            | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
            | where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

Read permissions to shared keys for the workspace are required. [See the documentation to learn more about workspace keys](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/platform/agent-windows#obtain-workspace-id-and-key)

customs.name: Tenant Permissions
customs.description: 'Security Administrator' or 'Global Administrator' on the workspace's tenant.

customs.name: Micorosft Purview Audit
customs.description: Microsoft Purview Audit (Standard or Premium) must be activated.

customs.name: Production Dataverse
customs.description: An active Dataverse in a production environment with the version higher or equal to 9.1.0000.09831. Read more on how to [verify your Dataverse version](https://docs.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/determine-org-id-name).

customs.name: Dataverse Audit Settings
customs.description: Have Administrator privileges in your Dataverse environment to enable auditing. Read more on [managing Dataverse auditing](https://docs.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/manage-dataverse-auditing).

instructionSteps.title: Connect Microsoft Dataverse audit logs to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: This connector uses the Office Management API to get your Dataverse audit logs. The logs will be stored and processed in your existing Microsoft Sentinel workspace. You can find the data in the **DataverseActivity** table.
